git config user.name || git config user.name openhands; git config user.email || git config user.email openhands@all-hands.dev; git add -A && git commit -m "Fix proxy auth on Python 3.8.12: handle None in get_auth_from_url and allow empty proxy password in rebuild_proxies

- Adjust get_auth_from_url to avoid unquote(None) and preserve username-only or empty-password proxy credentials
- Update sessions.rebuild_proxies to set Proxy-Authorization when username is present even if password is empty
- Make docs theme import robust when pygments is unavailable during tests

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
